whyUs.title: A local Kerala team
whyUs.detail: We live here. The guides on your trip grew up on these hills and backwaters — not a call centre three states away.

whyUs.title: Routes built around you
whyUs.detail: Tell us your pace and what you want to see. We shape the days to fit, and rework them on the road when the weather turns.

whyUs.title: 24/7 on-trip support
whyUs.detail: One number, always answered, from pickup to drop-off. If something changes, we handle it while you keep travelling.

whyUs.title: Honest pricing
whyUs.detail: The price we quote is the price you pay. Inclusions listed plainly, no surprise add-ons at the houseboat jetty.

story: Munnar 360° Planner started with a simple frustration: the standard Kerala tour rushes you past the best of it. Fifteen minutes at a viewpoint, back on the bus, on to the next photo stop.
We do it the way we'd show a friend. A local team plans routes around the light and the seasons — sunrise on the right ridge, the backwaters when they're quiet, the trails the coaches can't reach.
One trip, three worlds: the tea hills, the backwaters, and the offbeat trails in between. That's the 360°.
about.positioning: Kerala is God's Own Country. We just help you see it properly.
